slides.notes:
The three branches are not the same thing as federal, state, and local government. The Constitution grants federal powers and imposes limits; the Tenth Amendment reserves undelegated powers not prohibited to the states to the states or the people. Local governments generally operate under state law. Tribal governments have a distinct sovereign status and should not be folded into a simple federal-state-local ladder.

slides.notes:
House membership also includes nonvoting delegates and a resident commissioner, not counted in the 435 voting seats. House apportionment follows the census. The Seventeenth Amendment provides direct election of senators. Revenue bills originate in the House, though the Senate may propose or concur with amendments. Treaty consent is another Senate function, with a two-thirds threshold of senators present.

Under Article VI, the Constitution and federal laws made pursuant to it are supreme over conflicting state law. That does not mean every federal policy automatically displaces every state rule. Education, elections, public safety, and transportation often involve several governments and funding sources.
